resources.string: Discover shared interests before photos. Keep swiping, then crack the crystal together through conversation and optional missions. Existing capsules keep their progress when you switch modes. Photos are not anonymous or protected against screenshots.

Two bilateral exchanges or one mission answered by both unlock a level. Consecutive messages count as one turn. You can change questions without losing progress. Family and personal topics are chosen explicitly. Pause or leave to keep chatting behind the glass. Resuming and early reveal require both people. Reveal is permanent. Previously seen photos and known links remain accessible.
